'''Deer''' were four-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] animals found in the [[oro wood]]s of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. They were small creatures, colored bright [[Color/Legends|red]] with golden stripes. They fed on shoots in the undergrowth of the ancient forests.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe" /> The [[Orowood]] botanical [[Garden/Legends|garden]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] also had an oro wood forest with deer. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] toured the garden while the deer were grazing.<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

The [[Gallaze]], a quadrupedal herbivore native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]], were noted to be like deer.<ref name="DE">''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref> The [[Griff (creature)|griffs]] of [[Abonshee]] were noted to be deer-like.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Deer first appeared in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''.
